description: This file contains utility functions for handling request authorization, validation, and security checks in a FastAPI-based proxy server for a large language model (LLM) service. It includes functions for IP validation, request body safety checks, size limits, route management, and user identification, essential for securing and managing API requests in a proxy environment.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_request_ip_address( request: Request, use_x_forwarded_for: Optional[bool] = False )
methods.description: Extracts the client's IP address from the request, considering 'X-Forwarded-For' header if specified.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,Optional[str]] _check_valid_ip( allowed_ips: Optional[List[str]], request: Request, use_x_forwarded_for: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Checks whether the request's IP address is within the allowed list, considering proxy headers.

methods.name: bool check_complete_credentials(request_body: dict)
methods.description: Determines if the request body contains sufficient credentials and is not maliciously formatted.

methods.name: bool check_regex_or_str_match(request_body_value: Any, regex_str: str)
methods.description: Performs regex matching or string equality check between request value and pattern.

methods.name: bool _is_param_allowed( param: str, request_body_value: Any, configurable_clientside_auth_params: CONFIGURABLE_CLIENTSIDE_AUTH_PARAMS, )
methods.description: Verifies whether a specific parameter value is permissible based on client-side auth configuration.

methods.name: bool _allow_model_level_clientside_configurable_parameters( model: str, param: str, request_body_value: Any, llm_router: Optional[Router] )
methods.description: Checks if a model is authorized to use specific client-configurable parameters based on model info from the router.

methods.name: bool is_request_body_safe( request_body: dict, general_settings: dict, llm_router: Optional[Router], model: str )
methods.description: Validates if the request body is safe, primarily by inspecting banned params and credentials.

methods.name: pre_db_read_auth_checks( request: Request, request_data: dict, route: str, )
methods.description: Performs authentication checks before database read operations, including size limits, IP validation, and route restrictions.

methods.name: route_in_additonal_public_routes(current_route: str)
methods.description: Checks if a route matches a user-defined public route pattern, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: str get_request_route(request: Request)
methods.description: Extracts the route from the FastAPI request object, removing any base URL.

methods.name: bool check_if_request_size_is_safe(request: Request)
methods.description: Ensures the incoming request size is within limits for enterprise users.

methods.name: bool check_response_size_is_safe(response: Any)
methods.description: Ensures the response size does not exceed configured maximum size.

methods.name: bytes_to_mb(bytes_value: int)
methods.description: Converts bytes to megabytes.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,int]] get_key_model_rpm_limit( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Retrieves the RPM limit for models associated with a specific API key.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,int]] get_key_model_tpm_limit( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Retrieves the TPM limit for models associated with a specific API key.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,int]] get_model_rate_limit_from_metadata( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, metadata_accessor_key: Literal["team_metadata", "organization_metadata"], rate_limit_key: Literal["model_rpm_limit", "model_tpm_limit"], )
methods.description: Extracts model rate limits from user API key metadata.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,int]] get_team_model_rpm_limit( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Retrieves the RPM limit from team metadata.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,int]] get_team_model_tpm_limit( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Retrieves the TPM limit from team metadata.

methods.name: bool is_pass_through_provider_route(route: str)
methods.description: Checks if a route matches provider-specific pass-through prefixes.

methods.name: _has_user_setup_sso()
methods.description: Detects whether the user has configured SSO via environment variables.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_customer_user_header_from_mapping(user_id_mapping)
methods.description: Extracts the user header name for customer role from mapping configurations.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_end_user_id_from_request_body( request_body: dict, request_headers: Optional[dict] = None )
methods.description: Infers user ID from request headers or body fields, supporting multiple patterns.

methods.name: Optional[Union[str,List[str]]] get_model_from_request( request_data: dict, route: str )
methods.description: Determines the model identifier from request data or URL paths.

methods.name: str abbreviate_api_key(api_key: str)
methods.description: Shortens an API key for display purposes by keeping only last 4 characters.
